assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a panoramic editorial illustration for a formal Korean university partnership proposal.
Input image 1 is the sole subject and setting reference: the supplied local photograph of a table discussion. Transform this photograph into an illustration, retaining the actual people, their age range, clothing, seated posture, activity, and recognizable room. Preserve the four visible men: the partially framed man at the left in a dark traditional cap, pale shirt and gray waistcoat; the older man in a light blue shirt and patterned purple waistcoat; the man in a dark jacket and pale blue shirt; and the man at right with glasses, white shirt and blue waistcoat. Preserve the meeting table with water bottles, tea glasses, biscuit plates, documents and tissue box, and the glass partitions, ceiling beams, standing fan, windows, muted green structural columns and brick accents. Keep this a quiet everyday dialogue, with realistic bodies and naturally simplified faces.
Style: clean vector-like outlines with restrained gouache texture, polished, calm, dignified editorial illustration, suitable for a university-facing document. Use navy #0F2E54, blue #174EA6, cyan #069EEA and warm off-white #F5F2EB as the coherent palette, retaining natural skin tones and recognizable original clothing and room accents. Subtle shading and soft daylight, no cartoon exaggeration.
Composition: one full-bleed horizontal 2.5:1 panoramic image, approximately 2500 by 1000 pixels. Widen the room composition naturally if needed to fit the ratio, keeping the men and table readable and avoiding cropped heads or distorted hands. No frame or border.
Text and exclusions: absolutely no readable text, lettering, logos or watermark, including water-bottle branding and signs; replace all label characters with plain geometric blocks. No added people, flowers, bouquets, celebratory ceremony, certificates, diplomas, contracts, handshakes or approval seals. Do not imply university admission, employment, visa approval, accredited status or proven results. This is a photo-based depiction of dialogue only.
assets.intended_use: 현지 관계자 대화·협의 과정 설명용 사진 기반 삽화

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a panoramic editorial illustration for a formal Korean university partnership proposal, illustrating travel coordination and handoff procedures.
Input image 1 is the sole subject and setting reference: the supplied photograph of four adult visitors with luggage in a terminal. Transform the actual photograph into an illustration. Preserve the four middle-aged adult men, recognizable age range, hairstyle, glasses or sunglasses, relaxed standing poses and existing arms around shoulders. Preserve their actual clothing: left man in a muted sage-green polo and gray trousers; next man in a blue-and-white checked shirt and jeans; tall central man with glasses in a light cream blazer over a gray shirt and dark trousers; right man with sunglasses in a dark navy short-sleeve shirt and beige trousers. Keep the two upright silver ribbed wheeled suitcases, black backpack on the left suitcase, and beige travel bag on the central suitcase. Preserve the recognizable terminal architecture: curved dark steel roof and beams, overhead skylight strips, warm brick pillars and walls, glass entry doors and gray tiled floor. The original distant passersby may remain as quiet, indistinct background figures; add no people.
Style: clean vector-like outlines with restrained gouache texture, polished, calm, dignified editorial illustration, suitable for a university-facing document. Realistic anatomy and naturally simplified faces, no cartoon exaggeration. Use navy #0F2E54, blue #174EA6, cyan #069EEA and warm off-white #F5F2EB as a coherent palette, retaining natural skin tones, recognizable original clothing colors, muted brick warmth and realistic silver luggage. Soft daylight, restrained shading.
Composition: one full-bleed horizontal 2.5:1 panoramic image, approximately 2500 by 1000 pixels. Widen the terminal setting naturally to fit the ratio while keeping the four men together, complete heads, hands and luggage, with believable proportions. No frame or border.
Text and exclusions: absolutely no readable text, lettering, logos, flags, company branding or watermark. Simplify terminal signs, labels and luggage marks into blank geometric shapes. No bouquets, flowers, celebratory event, welcome banner, certificates, diplomas, visa stamps, approval symbols or added uniforms. Do not make the adults into students or imply a completed student arrival, admission, employment, visa approval, accredited status or proven results. Preserve the photo-based visitors and luggage as a general depiction for travel and handoff explanation only.
